method: Per-host NSW DoE filter status from on-network measurements, then same-site and category reasoning. See docs/nsw-doe-filtering.md.

legend.blocked: Measured blocked on a DoE network.
legend.likely-blocked: Same site as a measured block, or a category DoE blocks for students.
legend.likely-allowed: Measured reachable on a DoE network, or a service DoE itself uses.
